english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle with dangerous accessories / carriage of passengers dangerous - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[used a vehicle,]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle to be used,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(b) and 5(7)(a) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
